scripts.build: cd desktop && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev

SETUP_PASSWORD.description: Make up a password (at least 8 characters). You'll use it on your server's setup page to add your calendar and pair your phone. Keep it private.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Your AI key (an Anthropic API key for now) from [console.anthropic.com](https://console.anthropic.com). Set a monthly spending limit there too (Settings → Limits).
